modus, modī m.

noun, second declension

way, manner

Hōc modō, eōdem modō, ad hunc modum: “in this way, in the same way, like this”; servōrum modō, “in the manner of slaves”. Also “measure, limit”. “Manners” (behaviour) are mōrēs (see well-behaved).

Other words

  • ratiō, ratiōnis f. — method, way

    noun, third declension · also used · classical

    The way something is planned or reasoned out (see approach).

Examples

  • pavīmenta ad hunc modum facitō

    make the floors in this mannerCato Agr. 18

  • meminī super Pindarō poētā et Vergiliō in hunc fermē modum disserere

    I remember him discussing Pindar and Virgil roughly in this mannerGell. 17.10.1

See also approach, style, well-behaved, airplane mode.
